_meta.coverage_metric: planted-defect refusal rate by refusal code. A defect counts only when the checker exits non-zero AND names the code that owns it; a generic failure is not detection, because a checker that fails everything for one reason is indistinguishable from a working one at the exit status.
_meta.scope: This plane records what the local suite decides. It is not the repository skill-eval plane (evals/cases + evals/coverage.json); a claim here is closed by tests/run-all.sh on current repository bytes and by nothing else.
uncovered_by_design: whether a signal statement is true of the real product -- the checker validates evidence grade and shape, never the world
whether the compiled job hypothesis is the right one -- that is a USER-lane judgement with no deterministic oracle
whether an oracle's refutation condition is strong enough -- shape is checkable, adequacy is not
whether a capability edge that nobody declared should exist -- the compiler cannot know what was not observed

runnable.hollow_mutations: in-process temp copies of references/ carrying one planted defect each: source statement filed with an observation, attention filed as a pain, an observed mechanism with no oracle, a placeholder source_ref, an OBSERVED_ARTIFACT with a null observation, an unknown consumed field, an unbound signal dependency
runnable.expected: the committed signal set is green; every planted intake defect exits non-zero and names its own refusal code

runnable.hollow_mutations: a blanked job slot beside a populated workflow, an observable mechanism stripped of its oracle, a vendor claim regraded OBSERVED, a graded slot citing no signal, a PASS on product-market fit, an unbound capability edge, a usage right marked PASS
runnable.expected: the compiled dossier is green against its schema, its laws and its upstream digest; every planted dossier defect is refused by its own code

runnable.hollow_mutations: a USER-lane row closed by a DETERMINISTIC oracle, a closure claimed with no oracle, a blocked row marked PASS, a PASS on live provider execution
runnable.expected: the compiled matrix is green; a technical oracle offered as user validation is refused by name, which is the cheapest laundering path in the loop

runnable.hollow_mutations: an edge consuming a path its parent does not lease, two packets sharing a lease, a convergence owner on a non-convergence, a dependency cycle, an edge to a packet that does not exist, an entry condition pointing at conversation prose, a remaining item marked PASS
runnable.expected: the compiled handoff is green; every fabricated edge, shared lease and prose subject is refused by its own code

runnable.hollow_mutations: merge authority granted in the envelope, a surface asking for chain of thought, a surface reserving no Human operation, a branch reference outside consumer_binding, a dropped surface, an unbound stage dependency, two surfaces sharing a lease, and a catalogue with a surface silently removed
runnable.expected: the committed packet and catalogue are green and reconciled with each other; every planted authority, reasoning, topology and drift defect is refused by name

runnable.hollow_mutations: a hand-edited closure matrix that --check must reject, and a signal set stripped of every observable mechanism and graded magic moment, which the dossier compiler must refuse rather than compile into an empty MVP
covers: PREL-COMPILE-RED on an empty MVP scope
runnable.expected: all three committed projections are byte-identical on recompilation; a hand edit and an empty scope both exit non-zero

runnable.hollow_mutations: three distinct stale states, because they fail differently: an upstream artifact changed after its projection was compiled, a named subject whose bytes moved, and a named subject that is no longer on the tree
runnable.expected: each stale state is refused; a digest is otherwise only a promise about a file nobody re-reads
